_comment: Known war.gov/UFO (PURSUE program) data releases and mirror status. The site ingests a release once DenisSergeevitch/UFO-USA mirrors its PDFs (war.gov blocks our IPs). 'mirrored' releases are live in the corpus; 'pending-mirror' releases are surfaced as 'incoming' on the site and picked up automatically when corpus:sync sees the upstream manifest grow. The 'paths.localDir' field tells the war.gov MCP collector (corpus:fetch-war-gov) where to drop downloaded files. Edit here; the next build of public/work-available.json reflects changes.

releases.label: Release 01
releases.note: First PURSUE release. Mirrored and transcribed — this is the live corpus.

releases.label: Release 02
releases.note: Second PURSUE release. Video/audio-heavy (only 6 PDFs). MCP-based war.gov collector landed (corpus:fetch-war-gov, @unverified); still awaiting first live run + DenisSergeevitch/UFO-USA mirror as a parallel path.
